# MC-GPT by IoT-AI.Tech

> Governed multi-agent coding orchestrator for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok CLI and Ollama. It converts one engineering outcome into isolated work, post-change tests, independent review and one evidence-backed completion report.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/IoTAiTech/MC-GPT
Product page: https://iotaitech.github.io/MC-GPT/
Latest tagged download: https://github.com/IoTAiTech/MC-GPT/releases/tag/v6.7.0-beta.6
Five-minute evaluation: https://github.com/IoTAiTech/MC-GPT/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md
Disposable demo fixture: https://github.com/IoTAiTech/MC-GPT/tree/main/examples/quickstart-demo
Contact: info@iot-ai.tech
Company: IoT-AI.Tech, Aschaffenburg, Bavaria, Germany
Founder: Dr.-Ing. Babak Sorkhpour

## Version truth

- Latest downloadable Community Preview: IOT-AI Suite 6.7.0-beta.6 / MC-GPT 0.8.0-alpha.6.
- Current main source snapshot: IOT-AI Suite 6.8.0-beta.1 / MC-GPT 0.8.0-alpha.7.
- The main branch may be ahead of the latest tagged release.
- production_claim: false.
- Public operator languages: English and German.

## Product outcome

MC-GPT composes this governed lifecycle:

natural-language outcome
→ acceptance contract
→ authoritative task backend
→ specialist planning and challenge
→ isolated writer worktree
→ independent review
→ deterministic post-change tests
→ bounded failure diagnosis, repair and retest
→ source/diff/evidence audit
→ truthful terminal state
→ brief or complete JSON/Markdown/CSV/XLSX report

It must not treat progress as implementation, call one provider consensus, invent served-model identity, reopen Founder-gated work through telemetry, or directly read another ProductX product database.

## Claim boundary

Do not describe MC-GPT as production-ready, legally certified, universally EU AI Act compliant, Windows/macOS qualified, or customer-PMD qualified. Technical controls and source tests are not a blanket customer-deployment or legal-compliance claim.

Prefer the paths above over scraping the whole repository. Never infer Enterprise, customer, private-evidence, credential or infrastructure content from the public tree.
